stage: Stage 23: Recovery Control Plane & Autonomous Healing
phase: Phase 11: Cold-Restart Continuity & Governed Recovery Resumption

coldRestartScenarios.name: Pre-Dispatch Restart & Counter Preservation
invariants: Recovery request persisted prior to dispatch preserves retryCount, recoveryDepth, and originalOperationId
Restart never resets attempt counter to 0
Retry bounds (MAX_AUTOMATIC_RETRIES = 3) enforced across cold-boot cycles

coldRestartScenarios.name: Post-Dispatch Interruption with Epistemic UNKNOWN
invariants: In-flight action interrupted by restart preserves epistemicStatus: UNKNOWN
Blind retry is blocked; action is routed strictly to RECONCILE
No synthetic success or failure is fabricated upon boot

coldRestartScenarios.name: External Success During Downtime Detection
invariants: Stage 22 empirical verification takes precedence over interrupted recovery intent
Confirmed remote success halts recovery; recommended action transitions to WAIT
Duplicate side-effect execution is mathematically blocked

coldRestartScenarios.name: Partial Execution Continuity & High-Risk Gate
invariants: Completed steps in multi-step recovery are preserved across restart
Resumption begins at first pending/failed step, never replaying step 0
High-risk partial operations require Stage 21 operator approval before resuming

coldRestartScenarios.name: Compensation Plan Continuity & Anti-Double-Compensation
invariants: Compensation ID and reverse plan preserved across process restart
Already-compensated operations produce WAIT instead of second compensation
Connector permissions revalidated before resuming pending compensation

coldRestartScenarios.name: Reconciliation Counter Continuity & Escalation
invariants: Reconciliation attempt counter accumulates across restarts without reset
MAX_RECONCILIATION_ATTEMPTS (3) bounds total probe attempts
Exceeded attempts escalate cleanly to ESCALATE without infinite loop

coldRestartScenarios.name: Operator Approval Token TTL & Anti-Replay Defense
invariants: Approval token within 5m TTL allows resumption across restart
Expired approval token (>5m TTL) fails closed to REQUIRE_APPROVAL
Approval token bound to mismatched request/snapshot is rejected as stale

coldRestartScenarios.name: Stage 20 Policy Drift Detection & Active Revalidation
invariants: Registry version change across downtime marks persisted decision stale
Policy snapshot ID mismatch forces governance revalidation
Newly matching active DENY rule terminates recovery with ABORT

coldRestartScenarios.name: Stage 16 Connector Permission Revalidation
invariants: Revoked connector permission across restart halts recovery
Connector in ERROR health triggers REQUIRE_APPROVAL
Zero ambient authority retained from persisted records

coldRestartScenarios.name: Stage 12 Mission Constraint Resumption Gate
invariants: Recovery on paused mission suspended with PAUSE
Recovery on cancelled mission blocked with PAUSE
Unblocked running mission allows resumption following fresh revalidation

coldRestartScenarios.name: Cumulative Counter Monotonicity & Anti-Reset
invariants: retryCount accumulates strictly monotonically across multiple restarts
recoveryDepth bounded by MAX_RECOVERY_DEPTH (3)
Adversarial reset attacks via process reboot fail

coldRestartScenarios.name: Cascade Containment Preservation Across Restarts
invariants: Active ISOLATE containment survives restart without downgrade
Active ABORT and PAUSE containment survives crash
Containment controls cannot be circumvented by process restart

coldRestartScenarios.name: Single-Runtime Lease Expiry & Mutual Exclusion
invariants: Expired recovery lease after restart cannot be used to dispatch
Lease mutual exclusion prevents dual-worker collision during boot

coldRestartScenarios.name: Deterministic Idempotent Recovery Lookup
invariants: Multiple consecutive reboots return identical frozen decision objects
Lookup by requestId and operationId yields stable decision IDs

coldRestartScenarios.name: Causal Lineage & Audit Graph Preservation
invariants: causationId, correlationId, parentOperationId preserved across restart
Stage 22 Operation Trace and Causal Trace fully reconstruct lineage

coldRestartScenarios.name: Cold-Restart Security Hardening & Tampering Defense
invariants: Prototype pollution attempts in persisted records rejected with contract violation
Persisted records containing secrets (bearer, sk-, ghp_) rejected
Oversized payloads (>64KB) rejected
Forged lifecycle states loaded from disk rejected (returns null)
